description: cfd_2d_6dof_fish_x198_sym at 4 Hz on 2 ranks with a brain (X 193 0 0.3 1 0.5 0): from 0.3 s (the ramp and one tail beat) once per half tail beat the bearing of the target (X 192, ahead to the left) and the closing speed on it (towards 0.3 m/s) set the gait targets (X 199) of bias and frequency; vision: 7 rays from the head to the walls of the domain up to 0.5 L; the lateral line (X 194, 3 x 3 points per probe, two cells out) sampled each step; the decisions in REEF3D_6DOF_brain_0.dat.
